Overview


 Purpose                          This document describes the process for making reportability decisions(RD) and regulatory reporting to the United States Food and Drug Administration

                                   (FDA).

 Scope                              This document applies to all functions that perform activities related to medical device reportability decision making and reporting to the FDA in

                                   accordance with 21 CFR 803 and 820.
                                   NOTE: Reportability decisions and regulatory reportingrequirements tothe
                                   FDAalso apply to events occurring on US military baseslocated outside of the
                                   US.

Appendix D–Basic Requirements for Importersand
Distributors
Importers are required to submit MDR reportable events as follows:
-   Reports of device-related deaths and serious injuries must be reported to FDA and the manufacturer
-   Reports of device-related malfunctions must be reported to the manufacturer

Importersand Distributorsare also required to:
-   Develop, maintain, and implement written MDR procedures
-   Maintain files related to medical device adverse events

NOTE: These requirements are in effect unless the Importer/Distributorapplies and is granted an
exemption from FDA.
